name: hh_ru-mcp
description: hh.ru (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_hh_ru_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_hh_ru_client_id.description: client_id of an application registered at https://dev.hh.ru/admin; used to obtain an application token (grant_type=client_credentials at https://api.hh.ru/token).

platform_mcp_hh_ru_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_hh_ru_client_secret.description: client_secret of the same hh.ru application.

platform_mcp_hh_ru_user_agent.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HH_RU_USER_AGENT
platform_mcp_hh_ru_user_agent.description: Your application name and developer contact e-mail, e.g. 'MyApp/1.0 (me@example.com)'. hh.ru requires a User-Agent (or HH-User-Agent) naming the application and the developer's contact address ('Указание в заголовке названия приложения и контактной почты разработчика'); it is appended to the server's User-Agent.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /me with the application token answers the application profile (auth_type 'application').

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /vacancies (Поиск по вакансиям): text supports the hh.ru query language, page is 0-based (sent as page-1), per_page ≤ 100, and page×per_page may not exceed 2000 ('глубина возвращаемых результатов не может быть больше 2000'). The docs warn that without an authorization token a captcha is requested after the first call, so the server sends an application token. Region filters take area ids from /areas, so location/country are not sent. description is the search snippet (responsibility, may contain <highlighttext>); salary is salary.from/to in salary.currency (the gross flag stays in raw).
